title: Lilly 1647 first edition printed CHAP CXIII/editorial CXIV — General Fortune or Misery of the Native
authority: Wellcome b30338724 original 1647 source images PDF585–588
historical_scope: Source clauses and exceptions only: not independent life-event prediction evidence, no status of a real person's fortunes.

groups.source_group: Printed CHAP CXIII general fortune framework

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: CHAP CXIII Of the generall Fortune or Misery of the Native
claims.meaning_historical_only: The printed chapter CXIII (editorial CXIV) evaluates broad perceived fortune or misfortune, not specifically second-house financial wealth.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Having well considered the Geniture
claims.meaning_historical_only: Lilly instructs examining the natal figure as a whole before making a fortune judgment; this is a separate prerequisite.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Fortitudes and Debilities of the Planets
claims.meaning_historical_only: The strengths/debilities of several planets form the main source inputs for general fortune judgment.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: three or four Planets in their essential dignities
claims.meaning_historical_only: Three or four planets possessing essential dignities are a claimed favorable planetary ensemble, not proof of outcome.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: or if they receive one another out of such dignities
claims.meaning_historical_only: Mutual reception from essential dignities is offered as an alternative source of a favorable judgment; keep the 'or' separate.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: manifest and ample fortune
claims.meaning_historical_only: Under the author's favorable conditions, ample general fortune is forecast; no measured calibration is supplied.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: shall live gallantly and in much esteem
claims.meaning_historical_only: The author associates the favorable testimony with comfort and social esteem, not a measured independent trait.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: above the ordinary Vogue of his Birth
claims.meaning_historical_only: The predicted status is implicitly relative to a person's circumstances of birth, making base rates and social class essential controls.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: whole life ... for greatest part thereof
claims.meaning_historical_only: A favorable life is claimed for the greater part of life, not that every event must be good.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: most of the Planets ... Falls or Detriments
claims.meaning_historical_only: A majority of planets in fall or detriment is asserted as a negative general-life testimony.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: or in abject houses of Heaven
claims.meaning_historical_only: Planets in disadvantaged houses form a distinct purported unfavorable alternative.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: or Peregrine
claims.meaning_historical_only: Peregrine status is a separate alternative trigger; do not collapse it into detriment or cadency.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: involved with many infelicities
claims.meaning_historical_only: The author forecasts misfortunes when numerous such debilitations are present, without a quantified event rate.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: one mischiefe ever following
claims.meaning_historical_only: The pessimistic outcome is described with broad language and no prospective event-count threshold.

groups.source_group: Sun and Moon as independent additional testimonies

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Consider ... the Sun and Moon
claims.meaning_historical_only: Both luminaries are required to be considered in every nativity as extra witnesses to general fortune.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: their well or ill position
claims.meaning_historical_only: The author differentiates favorable and unfavorable placement for each luminary rather than treating their mere presence as evidence.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: if they concurre with the rest ... more assured
claims.meaning_historical_only: Concurrence of the luminaries with other planets is alleged to strengthen the outcome verdict; conflicting testimony must remain visible.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: some Planets essentially dignified, others wholly unfortunate
claims.meaning_historical_only: A mixed chart containing strong and extremely weak planets is said to produce intermediate or uneven fortune.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Significators are well fortified ... miserable ... houses
claims.meaning_historical_only: Strong significators in adverse houses offer another discordant source of uneven life fortune.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: or on the contrary
claims.meaning_historical_only: The source acknowledges the inverse mixed configuration rather than excluding it from the rule.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: unequall Fortune, variable ... great mutation
claims.meaning_historical_only: The resulting generalized claim is that fortune fluctuates, rather than staying uniformly favorable or unfavorable.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: life be extream happy ... other times most miserable
claims.meaning_historical_only: Lilly explicitly anticipates strong high/low reversals over different parts of one life.

groups.source_group: Promising nativity can be slow; directed event timing

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: very promising Nativity in the generall
claims.meaning_historical_only: Lilly explicitly introduces a countercase where the natal configuration looks promising.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: yet the events may come slowly
claims.meaning_historical_only: The author concedes apparently favorable natal outcomes can arrive late, undermining an unqualified near-term forecast.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: time ... depends upon Directions
claims.meaning_historical_only: Event occurrence time is said to require dynamic chart-direction calculations rather than interpreting natal strength alone.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: five Hylegicall places of Heaven
claims.meaning_historical_only: The text names directions of five Hylegical places as the event-time technique, without specifying the detailed computation on these pages.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Planets ... extreme fortitudes promise ... blessings
claims.meaning_historical_only: Extreme planetary strength is treated as a latent promise rather than evidence of when actual events happen.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Significators occourse to such Promittors
claims.meaning_historical_only: The time of the event is associated with significators meeting relevant promittors, with the exact event mapping to be established independently.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: as in the Radix did manifest such events
claims.meaning_historical_only: The promittor relationship is constrained by what the birth chart originally indicated; a future test must prefreeze this selection.

groups.source_group: Further negative condition sets—lights, dispositor and benefics

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: The two Lights peregrine
claims.meaning_historical_only: Both Sun and Moon being peregrine are named as an additional unfavorable configuration.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: their Dispositor in his Fall, Detriment
claims.meaning_historical_only: A dispositor in fall or detriment is another component of the negative-condition cluster.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: or in pittifull places
claims.meaning_historical_only: The dispositors' adverse house or place is an alternative phrase in the author's set of purported misfortune indicators.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Jupiter and Venus weak and peregrine
claims.meaning_historical_only: Jupiter and Venus in weak/peregrine states are additional alleged bad general-fortune testimonies.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: or unfortunate
claims.meaning_historical_only: A state of affliction for the benefics is included as an alternative or additional negative modifier.

groups.source_group: Further negative condition sets—malefics, significators, slowness

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Saturn and Mars in the same quarter
claims.meaning_historical_only: Saturn and Mars sharing the same quadrant of the sky is listed as another purported adverse condition.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Saturn Mars South Node and Mercury ... Significators
claims.meaning_historical_only: Saturn, Mars, lunar South Node and Mercury as principal happiness significators are linked to adverse outcomes; original glyph grouping has interpretation uncertainty.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: all the Planets slow in motion
claims.meaning_historical_only: Sluggish planetary motion across the whole chart is given as a separate condition; exact threshold is not defined here.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: many calamities ... misery for the most part
claims.meaning_historical_only: The source connects the additional adverse conditions to lengthy negative-life predictions, not independently measured events.

groups.source_group: Place-specific alleged cause and directional time

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: whence ... from the places ... Infortunes
claims.meaning_historical_only: Lilly says to infer the source/type of misfortune from the houses occupied by the malefic planets.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: time ... direction of Significators
claims.meaning_historical_only: Event timing in adverse cases also uses significator directions, not simply the static natal conditions.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: to their aspects or Bodies
claims.meaning_historical_only: The author names direction to planet bodies or aspects as targets for misfortune timing; exact admissible contacts are not calibrated here.
